slides.title: Title slide
slides.heading: My deck
slides.byline: Press → to advance, or use the phone remote
slides.notes:
These are speaker notes. They show on your phone and, with N, on screen.

They're the reason the slide can stay this quiet — put what you'll say here, not on the wall.

slides.title: A point with bullets
slides.heading: One idea per slide
bullets: A plain string becomes a bullet

bullets.text: An object adds a second line
bullets.sub: Good for a source or an aside

slides.notes:
Every field here is optional. Delete what you don't need.

See AGENTS.md for the full field reference, or run slidecast demo for a deck that demonstrates all fourteen layouts.

slides.title: Q: A discussion stop
slides.heading: What do you want them to remember?
slides.notes:
Adding "cls": "ask" inverts a slide to the dark treatment.

Use it for questions. The change in the room does the work, not the words.

The remote flags these so you can see one coming.
